main:
Send airtime or data to Zimbabwe 🇿🇼 from South Africa, from R5.

One dial does it all:
1️⃣ Buy a 1Voucher, OTT, Blu or FNB Voucher at your local store
2️⃣ Dial *130*31026*VoucherPIN*TheirNumber#
For example: *130*31026*VoucherPIN*263771234567# (their number with 263, without the first 0)

Works on Econet, NetOne and Telecel. Arrives in seconds. No app, no data, any phone.
Questions? WhatsApp +27 60 636 0061 💬

linkedin:
Zimbabwe is the biggest destination for airtime and data sent from South Africa through Fluxr, and the way people send it says a lot about what works.

There's no app to install and no bank card needed. A customer buys a 1Voucher, OTT, Blu or FNB Voucher at a local store and dials one USSD code with their family member's number in it: *130*31026*VoucherPIN*263…#. Seconds later an Econet, NetOne or Telecel number in Zimbabwe is topped up.

Building on cash vouchers and USSD keeps the service open to anyone with a basic phone, including people who don't have data on the day they want to send.

Interested in partnering with us, or in becoming a Fluxr Agent? Message us on WhatsApp at +27 60 636 0061 or visit www.fluxr.co.za.
